ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-white cubes with smooth, slightly translucent surface and firm edges, about 1.5-2 cm per side, scattered in a cluster on the upper-left of the greens, some with faint green tint at edges; firm, holds shape, no browning or glaze | 45
ITEM 2 | Bright orange cubes with matte, slightly moist surface and soft-looking edges, about 1.5-2 cm per side, clustered upper-right of the plate beside the greens, no char or glaze | 50
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens with ruffled, curly leaves in bright green and deep burgundy-red tones, slightly moist with faint sheen, forming a loose mound about 9 cm across covering the center of the plate, no dressing pooling visible | 45
ITEM 4 | Small scattered tan/brown specks, about 0.5 cm, dry and crumbly-looking, few pieces near the bottom edge of the greens, possibly seeds or nut fragments | 1
